newResources.title: Sunday Will Come
newResources.speaker: Joseph B. Wirthlin
newResources.description: Hear Elder Wirthlin remember loved ones and speak about the Resurrection. Notice how he speaks of missing them while expressing hope in Christ.
newResources.sourceEvidence: Full official text read, paragraphs on parents/sister/wife, sorrow, Resurrection, and hope in this life or the next. Native video preview is source page leading player image, distinct from speaker portrait.
newResources.claims: Wirthlin remembers parents, sister and wife; describes continued sorrow; connects hope to Resurrection. No timetable assigned to individual grief.

newResources.title: Jesus Christ Is Relief
newResources.speaker: Camille N. Johnson
newResources.description: Study President Johnson’s invitation to help carry another person’s burdens. Consider one practical form of care that the grieving person would welcome.
newResources.sourceEvidence: Full official text read, including three kinds of burdens and paragraphs connecting grief/mortal burdens with Mosiah18 care through other people. Native video preview is source page leading player image.
newResources.claims: Johnson distinguishes grief and mortal burdens from sin, discusses covenant care and temporal/spiritual relief; focusChrist does not apply self-reflective pride language as explanation of another person’s ongoing grief.
